title: Changelog
intro: What changed in GlassFolio, version by version.

v5-1.title: A new showcase and the self-hosting guide

highlights.showcase: A redesigned showcase built on real screens of the app, with a guided tour of the main features.
highlights.selfHostGuide: A step-by-step guide to run GlassFolio on your own computer or server with Docker.
highlights.pages: New pages: the project, the roadmap and this changelog.
highlights.aiLanguage: The assistant now always answers in the language of the interface.

highlights.cloud: GlassFolio is available online at app.glassfolio.dev, with your vault encrypted before it is stored.
highlights.selfHosted: A self-hosted edition with Docker, keeping your encrypted data on your own server.
highlights.signIn: Email sign-in with verification, authenticator codes (TOTP) and passkeys.
highlights.import: A universal import engine: more file formats, column mapping and snapshot reconciliation.
highlights.notifications: In-app notifications and alert rules on prices, gains and cash.
highlights.privacy: A complete privacy center: data export, account deletion, terms and legal notice.

highlights.mcp: A local MCP server to use your portfolio from AI clients such as Claude Desktop and Cursor.
highlights.assistant: An in-app assistant that answers questions and prepares operations for your approval.

highlights.tax: A tax assistant: flat tax versus progressive scale, Cerfa boxes and optimisation tips.
highlights.progress: Savings goals, investor ranks and DCA quests.
highlights.analytics: Sector analytics and richer market data.
highlights.design: A redesigned interface and global dashboard.

highlights.dashboard: A dashboard consolidating net worth, allocation and performance.
highlights.import: CSV import of transactions from your brokers.
highlights.valuation: Market valuation of positions with live prices.
